about:
EverGuard Solar was founded in 2008 in Albuquerque, New Mexico, as a family-owned solar installation and design company. The business began with a focus on serving New Mexico communities using local labor and regional expertise, and it has remained locally operated without outsourcing to out-of-state contractors.

The company designs and installs photovoltaic systems for residential, commercial, government, and industrial customers across the Albuquerque–Santa Fe metro area and beyond, including Rio Rancho, Los Lunas, Santa Fe, and Los Alamos. Its services cover grid-tied solar arrays, off-grid installations with battery storage, and assistance with financing options such as loans, leases, and power purchase agreements. EverGuard also helps clients navigate federal tax credits and state incentives to reduce upfront costs.

Customers range from homeowners seeking to lower electricity bills to commercial property owners, municipal facilities, and industrial sites looking for energy independence. The installer works with monocrystalline solar panels and offers battery systems for backup power, tailoring each project to the specific energy demands and roof conditions of the site.

EverGuard emphasizes its local dedication, stating that systems are built to meet the environmental demands of the Southwest and that every project is handled by New Mexican crews. The company cites a commitment to quality, craftsmanship, and customer satisfaction as the foundation of its decade-plus track record in the region.
